title: Features Section
description: Six responsive feature entries explaining vectors, forms, effects, CSS, responsive layouts, and reusable libraries.

data.title: Features that make Design simply awesome
data.subtitle: Not sure if Design is for you? Check out a few of the key features!

items.title: Vectors
items.description: Use SVGs that always stay crisp and you can change the color as you go.

items.title: Forms
items.description: Add forms to collect your visitors' emails directly with Mailchimp.

items.title: Effects
items.description: Add some fancy elements to your designs by adding interactive scroll effects or animations.

items.title: Paste CSS
items.description: Copy CSS from Photoshop or Sketch or even your text editor and paste it.

items.title: Responsive from the start
items.description: Have full control over mobile layouts. Move the breakpoints where it's best for the content.

items.title: Library
items.description: Choose from presets or create your own collections of elements to re-use later in your projects.
